summary: Tested (A) admin delete person feature and (B) OTP login regression. Backend: 7/7 relevant tests passing (3 QA delete targets skipped on rerun because already deleted). Frontend: OTP login works for all 4 demo roles routing to correct panel; admin can permanently delete customer/partner/merchant via Person360 → Delete → confirm-checkbox → Delete permanently; demo account delete is guarded with the expected 'Demo accounts cannot be deleted — they power demo login' toast. All required data-testid attributes (person-actions, action-delete, delete-confirm-check, delete-confirm) exist and gating logic is correct (delete-confirm disabled until checkbox ticked). Deleted users verified missing from DB.
critical_code_review_comments: Person360.jsx is very large (>1000 lines) — consider splitting into sub-modules (PersonActions, sections, drawers) for maintainability.

auth_service.send_otp / verify_otp look correct: dev_otp never leaked when sms is configured & non-demo; demo accounts bypass all rate limits; OTP expiry & attempt throttle enforced only for non-demo. Good.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 non-demo users used by the delete UI test: 'QA Delete Customer' (7000000101), 'QA Delete Partner' (7000000102), 'QA Delete Merchant' (7000000103). All three were consumed (deleted) as part of the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If retesting delete UI, re-seed the 3 QA users first (see backend/tests/test_delete_person_and_otp.py QA_TARGETS mapping; use models.user.build_user with is_demo=False). The frontend admin route uses tab query param, e.g. /admin?tab=customers|partners|merchants. Confirmed testids: person-actions, action-delete, delete-confirm-check, delete-confirm. Demo guard returns HTTP 400 with detail containing 'Demo accounts cannot be deleted'.
rca of the issue: N/A — both features working as specified.
